  4. 令 \(X_i=\{J_h:h<i\}\)；存在有限严格递增序列 \(j_0,\ldots,j_{\ell-1}<i\) 使 \(((J_{j_0},\ldots,J_{j_{\ell-1}}),J_i)\in\mathsf{Rule}_{subset}(X_i)\)；
  5. 令 \(X_i=\{J_h:h<i\}\)；存在有限严格递增序列 \(j_0,\ldots,j_{\ell-1}<i\) 使 \(((J_{j_0},\ldots,J_{j_{\ell-1}}),J_i)\in\mathsf{Rule}_{mandatory}(X_i)\)；
  6. 存在有限严格递增序列 \(j_0,\ldots,j_{\ell-1}<i\) 使 \(((J_{j_0},\ldots,J_{j_{\ell-1}}),J_i)\in\mathsf{Rule}_{disj}\)；
  7. 存在 \(j,k<i\) 使 \(((J_j,J_k),J_i)\in\mathsf{Rule}_{eq}(\mathcal S)\)；
  8. 存在 \(j,k<i\) 使 \(((J_j,J_k),J_i)\in\mathsf{Rule}_{clash}\)。

11. 事实查询与 ORM 闭包证书

math.tex: e_O:\mathbb N\to N_O,\qquad e_V:\mathbb N\to N_V.

\operatorname{TypedName}(t,a)
\Longleftrightarrow
(t\in O\wedge a\in N_O)\vee(t\in V\wedge a\in N_V).

\operatorname{RoleWF}(\mathcal S)
\Longleftrightarrow
\forall f\in F\ \forall i<\operatorname{ar}(f)\ \forall t,u\in O\cup V\,
\bigl(\operatorname{Plays}(f,i,t)\in\mathcal S\wedge\operatorname{Plays}(f,i,u)\in\mathcal S\Rightarrow t=u\bigr).

t(a)\in\mathsf{At}_{ORM}
\quad((t\in O\wedge a\in N_O)\vee(t\in V\wedge a\in N_V)),

f(a_0,\ldots,a_{n-1})\in\mathsf{At}_{ORM}
\quad(f\in F,\ \operatorname{ar}(f)=n,\ a_i\in N_O\cup N_V\text{ 对所有 }i<n),

a\approx b\in\mathsf{At}_{ORM},\quad a\not\approx b\in\mathsf{At}_{ORM}
\quad(a,b\in N_O\cup N_V),
\theta_O:O\to O,\quad \theta_F:F\to F,\quad \theta_V:V\to V,\quad \theta_N:N_O\cup N_V\to N_O\cup N_V

\theta(t(a))=
\begin{cases}
\theta_O(t)(\theta_N(a)), & t\in O,\\
\theta_V(t)(\theta_N(a)), & t\in V,
\end{cases}
\quad
\theta(a\approx b)=\theta_N(a)\approx\theta_N(b),
\quad
\theta(a\not\approx b)=\theta_N(a)\not\approx\theta_N(b),
\quad
\theta(\bot_{\mathcal K})=\bot_{\mathcal K}.

\operatorname{Sub}_{ORM}
=
\{\theta:\theta_O:O\to O,\theta_F:F\to F,\theta_V:V\to V,\theta_N:N_O\cup N_V\to N_O\cup N_V,
\operatorname{ar}(\theta_F(f))=\operatorname{ar}(f)\text{ 对所有 }f\in F,
\theta_N(N_O)\subseteq N_O,\theta_N(N_V)\subseteq N_V,
\{o\in O:\theta_O(o)\ne o\},\{f\in F:\theta_F(f)\ne f\},
\{v\in V:\theta_V(v)\ne v\},\{a\in N_O\cup N_V:\theta_N(a)\ne a\}\text{ 均有限}\}.
\mathsf{Ax}_{ORM}(\mathcal K)=\mathcal S\cup\mathcal A\cup\{a\approx a:a\in N_O\cup N_V\}.

\mathsf{Rule}_{uniq}=
\{((f(\bar a),f(\bar b),\operatorname{Unique}(f,I)),a_j\approx b_j):
f\in F,\ n=\operatorname{ar}(f),\ I\subseteq n,\ j<n,
\bar a,\bar b:n\to N_O\cup N_V,\ \forall i\in I\ a_i=b_i\}.

\mathsf{Rule}_{subset}(X)=
\{((\langle f(\bar a),\operatorname{Subset}(f,I,g,J)\rangle\mathbin{\smallfrown}
\langle\operatorname{Plays}(g,j,t_j):j<n\rangle,g(\bar b)):
\operatorname{ar}(f)=m,\operatorname{ar}(g)=n,
k\in\mathbb N,\ I\in\mathsf{PosSeq}(f,k),\ J\in\mathsf{PosSeq}(g,k),
\bar a:m\to N_O\cup N_V,\ \bar t:n\to O\cup V,\ \bar b:n\to N_O\cup N_V,
\forall q<k\ (b_{J(q)}=a_{I(q)}),
\forall j<n\ \operatorname{TypedName}(t_j,b_j),\
\forall j<n\bigl(j\notin\operatorname{rng}(J)\Rightarrow
b_j=\operatorname{freshORM}(t_j,\operatorname{Names}_{ORM}(X)\cup\{b_\ell:\ell<j,\ \ell\notin\operatorname{rng}(J)\})\bigr)\}.

\mathsf{Rule}_{mandatory}(X)
=
\{((\langle t_i(a),\operatorname{Mandatory}(f,i)\rangle\mathbin{\smallfrown}
\langle\operatorname{Plays}(f,j,t_j):j<n\rangle,f(\bar b)):
f\in F,n=\operatorname{ar}(f),i<n,
\bar t:n\to O\cup V,\ \bar b:n\to N_O\cup N_V,
\operatorname{TypedName}(t_i,a),\ b_i=a,
\forall j<n\ \operatorname{TypedName}(t_j,b_j),\
\forall j<n\bigl(j\ne i\Rightarrow
b_j=\operatorname{freshORM}(t_j,\operatorname{Names}_{ORM}(X)\cup\{b_\ell:\ell<j,\ \ell\ne i\})\bigr)\}.

\mathsf{Rule}_{disj}=
\{((f(a_0,\ldots,a_{m-1}),g(b_0,\ldots,b_{n-1}),\operatorname{Disjoint}(f,I,g,J)),\bot_{\mathcal K}):
\operatorname{ar}(f)=m,\operatorname{ar}(g)=n,
k\in\mathbb N,\ I\in\mathsf{PosSeq}(f,k),\ J\in\mathsf{PosSeq}(g,k),
\bar a:m\to N_O\cup N_V,\ \bar b:n\to N_O\cup N_V,
\forall q<k\ a_{I(q)}=b_{J(q)}\}.

\mathsf{Rule}_{eqO}
=
\{((a\approx b,t(a)),t(b)):
((t\in O\wedge a,b\in N_O)\vee(t\in V\wedge a,b\in N_V))\},

\mathsf{Rule}_{eqF}(\mathcal S)
=
\{((a_i\approx b,f(a_0,\ldots,a_i,\ldots,a_{n-1})),f(a_0,\ldots,b,\ldots,a_{n-1})):
f\in F,\operatorname{ar}(f)=n,i<n,a_0,\ldots,a_{n-1},b\in N_O\cup N_V,
\operatorname{AllowedName}_{\mathcal S}(f,i,a_i),
\operatorname{AllowedName}_{\mathcal S}(f,i,b)\}.

\mathsf{Delta}_{ORM}
=
\bigl(
\mathsf{RolePos},
\mathsf{PosSeq},
\operatorname{TypedName},
\operatorname{RoleWF},
\mathsf{TypedPos}_{(-)},
\operatorname{RoleType}_{(-)},
\operatorname{AllowedName}_{(-)},
\{\operatorname{Plays}(f,i,t):f\in F,\ i<\operatorname{ar}(f),\ t\in O\cup V\},
\{\operatorname{Mandatory}(f,i):f\in F,\ i<\operatorname{ar}(f)\},
\mathsf{Rule}_{plays},
\mathsf{Rule}_{uniq},
\mathsf{Rule}_{subset}(-),
\mathsf{Rule}_{disj}
\bigr).

\operatorname{Step}^{ORM}_{plays}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{t(a_i)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{ORM},\
f\in F,n=\operatorname{ar}(f),i<n,t\in O\cup V,\
f(a_0,\ldots,a_{n-1})\in S,\
\operatorname{Plays}(f,i,t)\in S,\
\operatorname{TypedName}(t,a_i)\}.

\operatorname{Step}^{ORM}_{mandatory}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{f(\bar b)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{ORM},\
f\in F,n=\operatorname{ar}(f),i<n,\bar t:n\to O\cup V,\bar b:n\to N_O\cup N_V,\
\operatorname{Mandatory}(f,i)\in S,\ \forall j<n\ (\operatorname{Plays}(f,j,t_j)\in S),\
t_i(a)\in S,\ b_i=a,\ \forall j<n\ \operatorname{TypedName}(t_j,b_j),\
\forall j<n\bigl(j\ne i\Rightarrow
b_j=\operatorname{freshORM}(t_j,\operatorname{Names}_{ORM}(S)\cup\{b_\ell:\ell<j,\ell\ne i\})\bigr)\}.

\operatorname{Step}^{ORM}_{uniq}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{a_j\approx b_j\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{ORM},\
f\in F,n=\operatorname{ar}(f),I\subseteq n,j<n,\
\bar a,\bar b:n\to N_O\cup N_V,\
f(\bar a)\in S,\ f(\bar b)\in S,\operatorname{Unique}(f,I)\in S,\
\forall i\in I\ (\bar a(i)=\bar b(i))\}.

\operatorname{Step}^{ORM}_{subset}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{g(\bar b)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{ORM},\
f,g\in F,\operatorname{ar}(f)=m,\operatorname{ar}(g)=n,\
k\in\mathbb N,I\in\mathsf{PosSeq}(f,k),J\in\mathsf{PosSeq}(g,k),\
\bar a:m\to N_O\cup N_V,\bar t:n\to O\cup V,\bar b:n\to N_O\cup N_V,\
f(\bar a)\in S,\operatorname{Subset}(f,I,g,J)\in S,\
\forall j<n\ (\operatorname{Plays}(g,j,t_j)\in S\wedge\operatorname{TypedName}(t_j,b_j)),\
\forall q<k\ (\bar b(J(q))=\bar a(I(q))),\
\forall j<n\bigl(j\notin\operatorname{rng}(J)\Rightarrow
b_j=\operatorname{freshORM}(t_j,\operatorname{Names}_{ORM}(S)\cup\{b_\ell:\ell<j,\ell\notin\operatorname{rng}(J)\})\bigr)\},

\operatorname{Step}^{ORM}_{disj}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{\bot_{\mathcal K}\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{ORM},\
f,g\in F,\operatorname{ar}(f)=m,\operatorname{ar}(g)=n,\
k\in\mathbb N,I\in\mathsf{PosSeq}(f,k),J\in\mathsf{PosSeq}(g,k),\
\bar a:m\to N_O\cup N_V,\bar b:n\to N_O\cup N_V,\
f(\bar a)\in S,g(\bar b)\in S,\operatorname{Disjoint}(f,I,g,J)\in S,\
\forall q<k\ (\bar a(I(q))=\bar b(J(q)))\}.

\operatorname{Step}^{ORM}_{eqO}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{t(b)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{ORM},\
t\in O\cup V,a,b\in N_O\cup N_V,\
a\approx b\in S,t(a)\in S,\
((t\in O\wedge a,b\in N_O)\vee(t\in V\wedge a,b\in N_V))\},

\operatorname{Step}^{ORM}_{eqF}(\mathcal K)
=
\{(S,S\cup\{f(a_0,\ldots,b,\ldots,a_{n-1})\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{ORM},\
f\in F,\operatorname{ar}(f)=n,i<n,a_0,\ldots,a_{n-1},b\in N_O\cup N_V,\
a_i\approx b\in S,f(a_0,\ldots,a_i,\ldots,a_{n-1})\in S,\
\operatorname{AllowedName}_{\mathcal S}(f,i,a_i),
\operatorname{AllowedName}_{\mathcal S}(f,i,b)\},

\operatorname{Step}^{ORM}_{clash}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{\bot_{\mathcal K}\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{ORM},\
a,b\in N_O\cup N_V,a\approx b\in S,a\not\approx b\in S\}.
